verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitHub runs CI/CD pipelines through GitHub Actions. Metered Actions minutes imply platform-hosted execution, but nothing documents running pipelines on private, self-hosted runners or a centralized view across runners. The only mention of self-hosted runners is an old community comment naming them as something GitHub would need, which is a wish rather than proof of the capability. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted/private runner support, centralized visibility across hosted and private runners, explicit documentation of hosted runners, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run pipelines on platform-hosted runners or my own private runners with centralized visibility

citations.quote: Automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows right in your repository with GitHub Actions.
Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD.
